purpose: Perform bounded deterministic calculation-driven subtractive 3D fabrication: extruded profile cuts, round through-holes, and tolerance-aware round sockets with explicit kerf and evidence receipts.

properties.path: target .glb file outside the protected live machine body
properties.specification: closed axm.precision-cutter/v0.1 recipe using profile-cut, round-through-hole, or round-socket

contains: exact output GLB bytes and SHA-256
cut geometry vertex and triangle counts
profile, removed-area, kerf, or socket-clearance metrics as applicable
explicit NOT_TESTED boundaries for visual quality, UV continuity, structural strength, and physical laser behavior

relationships: reuses the existing bounded surface-to-GLB encoder and geometry validator rather than introducing a second mesh publication path
acts as a subtractive Creative Hand alongside additive primitive, sticker, and assembly workflows
round-socket converts source radius plus requested clearance and kerf into measurable receiving geometry
outputs ordinary GLB assets that can enter existing observers, aftertouch, games, stickers, and profession workflows
does not duplicate executable-anatomy coverage already proven by AXM-CAP-GENERATE-PROCEDURAL-3D; its dependency and source remain explicit instead
limitations: v0.1 is a bounded software fabrication cutter, not general arbitrary-mesh CSG. It creates new cut solids from explicit profiles or rectangular stock rather than subtracting directly from an imported arbitrary GLB.
profile-cut supports arbitrary simple 2D profiles extruded through Y thickness but does not yet offset arbitrary polygon boundaries for kerf; kerf is applied to round holes and sockets.
round-through-hole and round-socket currently support one round cutout per recipe in rectangular stock, with 8..128 radial segments.
UVs, texture continuity, material seam finishing, physical strength, heat effects, real laser-machine parameters, rendered appearance, and host-engine compatibility are not proven by this capability.
cut geometry is exact relative to the declared polygonized recipe; circular boundaries are finite-segment approximations and both analytic and polygonized measurements remain visible.

truth.basis: Every cutter recipe, kerf/clearance input, generated surface, exact GLB digest, measured cut metric, and untested quality boundary remains explicit.

agency.basis: The caller controls the cut operation, dimensions, profile, kerf, clearance, material, destination, and replacement decision; the cutter does not silently select design intent.

continuity.basis: Output publication reuses UC's atomic GLB path and rollback behavior; the live machine body remains protected.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Recipes are bounded and fail closed on invalid/self-intersecting profiles, impossible round cuts, malformed materials, unsafe output paths, and generated GLB verification failures.
